The clinic's concept is truly brilliant, especially if you're staying at Sole Mio, as we were. They offer a wide variety of treatments, which is very appealing. For our first experience, we opted for an Oil Massage and booked the last appointment of the day, at 6:30 pm.

I have to say that, despite the excellent reviews the center has, it unfortunately didn't meet our expectations. The staff was very friendly throughout, but the service we received wasn't up to the price we paid.

Upon arrival, the first thing they asked us to do was pay, as it was the last appointment and they were about to close. Then, they directed us to the room while briefly asking which areas we wanted treated and which we preferred to avoid. Once inside, they quickly relayed our instructions to the massage therapists at the door.

The room was quite cold, and the therapists were talking amongst themselves during the session, which disrupted the relaxation necessary to enjoy the massage. Halfway through the session, a cell phone rang and someone started talking (I don't know if it was a video or audio message), which completely shattered what little peace there was.

During my 18-day trip to Thailand, we tried various wellness centers and spas, including some high-end ones, and I can safely say that this was the worst.

From the initial contact to the way they operated, everything was very impersonal. There was no questionnaire before the massage (something standard practice in professional centers) asking about medical conditions, desired intensity, pregnancy, or any other relevant medical issues.

After this experience, we honestly had no desire to try any other treatments at the clinic.
